title: Ur's Whimsy
summary: I built **Ur's Whimsy**, a multiplayer revival of *Glitch* featuring floaty low-gravity platforming, customizable Glitchen avatars, point-and-click verb popups, real-time skill training with Brain Capacity penalties, Giant Favor shrines, and all five interconnected areas (`Beau's Home Street` in both `Lost Woods` and `Vam Road` styles, `Chego Chase`, `Andra Bureaucratic Hall` with its 10-second waiting chairs and frog bureaucrats, `Bongul Beat`, and `Goli Grabs`). Players can cooperatively mine Beryl rocks with swinging pickaxe thought bubbles for bonus chunks, squeeze chickens, massage or milk butterflies, race wind-up Cubimals measured in planks, match daily Hi-Signs, trigger synchronized Pumpkin Ale Thriller dances and Random Kindness rainbows, and explore accompanied by a procedural WebAudio soundtrack and sound effects.
